fusions.name: Harness Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes the target with a length of harness for 6 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slowing it by 25% for 2 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Hauled In
fusions.desc: Casts a chain into the first enemy in line for 13 damage and hauls you up to 7 tiles to it, leaving it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Picket Line
fusions.desc: Stakes a chained picket line 6 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds that blocks enemies, slowing anything that strikes it by 25% for 2 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tethered Colt
fusions.desc: A colt on a chain lead fights beside you, kicking enemies within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds and slowing them by 20% for 2 seconds.
